data.narrative:
Ares Industries is a Series A defense and security company founded by Alex Tseng and Devan Plantamura that has raised $31M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a peer universe of 11 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies, comprising 2 public comps (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers including Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Castelion.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $31M total raised as a proxy base and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage progression, implying a $62M valuation. Peer-median analysis examines 11 Defense & Security companies at Series B and adjacent stages, yielding a $1.0B median valuation across a range of $125M to $3.0B. Representative peer data points include Dream Security at $3.0B, Allen Control Systems at $2.2B, and Harmattan AI at $1.4B.

The triangulated valuation range spans $53M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $531M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty in stage-appropriate multiples within the Defense & Security sector and limited direct comparability at the Series A stage. Key sensitivities include revenue traction, customer concentration, and defensibility of technology differentiation relative to more mature Series B peers in the comp set.
